QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] Master Lyck, Top Chef
QuestInfo.0: The only way to get Muto to move is to make delicious food that he likes. But all the ingredients in this place are bizarre and you don't know how to prepare them. Go find Master Lyck, the top chef of Chu Chu Village. Just beware his temper...
QuestInfo.1: The only way to get Muto to move is to make delicious food that he likes. But all the ingredients in this place are bizarre and you don't know how to prepare them. Go find Master Lyck, the top chef of Chu Chu Village. Just beware his temper...
QuestInfo.2: You took Lyon's advice and met Master Lyck, who wants your help completing his special dish. Is he just pawning work off on you...?
